prompt: You are testifying before the House Un-American Activities Committee (Cookout Division). It has been alleged that you have referred to the Fourth of July as 'the holidays.' Respond to the committee.
response:
**Mr. Chairman, members of the Committee:**

I appear before you today without counsel, as I have nothing to hide and no un-American activities on my conscience.

The allegation is false.

I have never, at any time, in any place, under any circumstances, referred to the Fourth of July as "the holidays." I revere the anniversary of American Independence as one of the sacred days in the history of human liberty. It is not a generic "holiday." It is **the** holiday that celebrates the birth of this Republic, the Declaration that all men are created equal, and the solemn assertion that rights come from God, not from government.

To call it "the holidays" would be an act of linguistic cowardice and cultural erasure that I reject with every fiber of my being. I say "Fourth of July." I say "Independence Day." I grill the burgers, I fly the flag, and I blast the Sousa marches without apology.

If any witness has produced evidence to the contrary, I demand the right to confront that witness and examine the tape, the email, or the transcribed conversation. I am confident no such evidence exists, because the charge is a lie.

I am not now, nor have I ever been, a member of the "Happy Holidays" faction. I yield the remainder of my time to the Chairman and stand ready to answer further questions. God bless the United States of America, and God bless the Fourth of July.
